static_traits.name: Wei Sili
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, with no immediate family members
static_traits.social_status: Has a group of friends to talk with, but not yet confided this trouble to them; interactions with friends and colleagues strained due to insecurity
static_traits.medical_history: without significant physical illness;without previous psychotherapy experience;without similar psychological problems in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly good logic; able to self-observe 'easily jumping to conclusions'; cooperativeness fair but skeptical attitude; steady speech rate, emotional experience 'heavy' but can be spoken of

basic_info.main_problem: When donating clothes at a donation center, the other person did not smile at me yet, and I immediately assumed she thought my donated clothes were not good enough; since then I keep feeling Anxiety and insecurity, repeatedly Self-doubting.
basic_info.core_demands: Hoping to cope with and effectively manage this insecurity and Anxiety so they no longer affect daily life and interpersonal interaction.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' recognition

special_situations.event: When handing over old clothes at the donation center, the clerk did not smile or respond positively
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others do not give positive feedback or smiles, it means my things (and I) are not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding situations of being evaluated, restraining expression to Self-protect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: She thinks my clothes are worthless, so I am not worthy of being valued either

special_situations.event: When interacting with friends or colleagues, the other party's reaction not warm enough or without clear Approval
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If friends do not explicitly affirm, it means they look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing sharing of opinions, lowering self-exposure to avoid being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am not good enough/I am not recognized

special_situations.event: Recalls the donation incident or encounters similar cold reactions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Being ignored once means being negated in the future too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Retreats in advance and avoids involvement to lower the possibility of being hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will be looked down on again in similar future scenarios

special_situations.event: Needing to express opinions or show works (such as poems) in social settings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I expose my inadequacies, it will confirm 'not good enough' and I will be negated
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing expression and display, choosing silence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I speak up I will be negated

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen and recognized, expecting his efforts and work to be affirmed
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being evaluated as not good enough, Being rejected, or humiliated
defense_goal: Staying distant and restrained in expression to avoid the hurt of being negated
Lowering Anxiety through Self-protection and avoiding situations

object_relations.object_representation: A picky, judgmental other (who negates and rejects)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites examining evidence, generating alternative explanations, or proposing exercises
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feeling one may be questioned or Demanded to prove value; if done poorly, will be negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Has a restrained tone, emphasizes 'evidence' and 'logic', uses few emotional words, and keeps a reserved, wait-and-see attitude

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited in counseling to express more about personal feelings and their link to self-worth
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying that expressing vulnerability will be looked down upon or negated
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Describes events in calm, generalized language, tries to avoid emotional details, and quickly turns to problem analysis

manifestations: Even with friends, not yet talked about the troubles, keeping emotions sealed away
Withdrawing in relationships for fear of being judged, reducing self-exposure
outcomes: Increased dependence of self-worth on others' feedback

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly questioning self-worth in counseling, worrying about being negated
Repeatedly weighs before expressing, emphasizing that 'evidence' is needed before daring to shake an idea
Skeptical and wait-and-see toward new perspectives, cautiously engaging with emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language examples: 'forget it, I will endure it','I should not trouble others', etc.
manifestations: Reducing sharing of opinions and works in interpersonal interactions to Self-protect
Not actively seeking help or talking about troubles even with friends' support
Tends to retract deeper expression during counseling

positive_force: Values helping others and positive feedback, with empathy and a sense of responsibility
Willing to actively seek professional help and participate in exercises
Having some self-observation and awareness ability (able to identify 'jumping to conclusions')
High education level, clear verbal expression; favorable for cognitive restructuring
Occupational functioning basically maintained (Work not yet directly affected)
negative_force: High dependence on external recognition, tying self-worth to others' reactions
Cognitive biases: jumping to conclusions/mind reading, overgeneralization, predicting the future
Interpersonal Withdrawal and avoidance, reducing access to positive feedback
Rumination and intensified Self-doubt and Anxiety experience
Skeptical of new perspectives, reducing motivation for change and behavioral attempts

antecedent: In social settings, needs to express views or show work
The other party responds coldly or lacks positive feedback
Recalling the cold interaction at the donation center
target_behavior.core_reason: The belief equating others' immediate reactions directly with self-worth, triggering catastrophic Anticipation of being negated
target_behavior.function: Escaping the pain of being judged and shamed, protecting self-esteem and emotions in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, reduced opportunities for support and positive feedback, Further decline in sense of self-worth

target_behavior.behavior: Over-interprets others' attitudes and makes negative automatic inferences
antecedent: Observes ambiguous cues such as others lacking smiles or approval
Being in unfamiliar or evaluative situations
target_behavior.core_reason: Preference for threatening Interpretations of uncertain cues and need for control
target_behavior.function: Tries to gain a sense of control and prevent being hurt by assuming the worst outcome in advance
target_behavior.consequence: Rising Anxiety, rumination and Increased avoidance behavior, further damaging social interaction and emotional stability
